description: This Java class 'CacheDirective' provides utilities for parsing, creating, and representing cache control directives compliant with RFC 2616, specifically handling 'max-age' and 'no-cache' directives.

classes.name: CacheDirective
classes.description: A utility class for parsing and creating cache directives such as 'max-age' and 'no-cache' for HTTP caching policies.

methods.name: maxAgeDirective
methods.description: Creates a CacheDirective with a specified max-age in seconds, throws IllegalArgumentException if maxAge <= 0.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Parses a string directive into a CacheDirective object; returns null if parsing fails.

methods.name: isCachingAllowed
methods.description: Returns true if caching is permitted (i.e., not 'no-cache').

methods.name: getMaxAge
methods.description: Returns the maximum age in seconds for caching.
